body:
SOURCE PREFLIGHT FOR bd-01M1C8WSZ49M7SHG2HMQCWRK6E — no path claimed and no edits made.

I read ADR 0002 D10, the output-bundle S1-S4 summary, the bead, and current align/view sources. Existing semantic vocabulary is sufficient for the acceptance court; I do not see a need for a new public Scala type merely to freeze the mapping:
- per-unit P and hierarchy/mode mass: HsmmResult.posterior -> AlignmentMatrix/AlignmentRow over AlignState.Source, Distorted(facets), and External;
- ambiguity and support: row source/external mass, localizability(sourceNodeCount), topK, and explicit Unranked;
- source coverage: AlignmentMatrix.columnMass, with omission only under a declared lawful threshold/universe;
- route evidence: HsmmResult.flow -> TransitionFlow/FlowStep plus the Viterbi path labelled as one summary, never the posterior;
- elaboration: RecallGraph relations already carry ElaborationEdge;
- inspectable linkage: AlignRef.Cell and AlignRef.Transition already pass through ViewRef.Align.

The missing seam is exactly what the bead says: view has no lowering from HsmmResult/P/F. The court can therefore be renderer-neutral and pre-implementation.

Proposed mutation ledger:
1. Anna: kill any lowering that drops a posterior row, a recall unit id, or its exact source anchors.
2. sharp atomic anchor: kill normalization/scaling that blurs a concentrated atomic placement.
3. scene gist/compression: kill leaf-only rendering or collapse of Segment mass.
4. bimodal blend: kill argmax-only or Viterbi-only rendering.
5. role reversal: kill merging Distorted facets into faithful mass or a generic mismatch.
6. backward transition: kill sorting by source order or deriving route only from row MAP states instead of F.
7. external association: kill folding an attributable ExternalState into intrusion or anchored mass.
8. Unranked: kill presenting aligner support failure as participant behaviour.
9. omitted/missing channel: kill treating missing/ineligible/imputed/refused evidence as numeric zero or ordinary omission.
10. renderer failure: kill any design in which a failed S4 preview erases an otherwise valid S3 semantic result.

I would also require exact input identities for source, recall, GraphHsmm config, candidate/provider/geometry when present, P row unit ids, F endpoints, and current source node ids; future film edition/presentation identities remain required only once C1 supplies them, never fabricated for text.

I remain available for explicit assignment of this one-path documentation slice or redirection.
